Class Var<A>

java.lang.Object
forj.http.Var<A>
All Implemented Interfaces:
Segment
public final class Var<A> extends Object implements Segment
A typed path segment: Path.of("/users").then(LongVar) matches /users/7 and hands the handler a long. A segment that doesn't parse is no match, so the router tries the next route (as in http4s), and with none left the answer is 404, not 400.

Built in: IntVar, LongVar, UuidVar (canonical form only) and StringVar (any non-empty segment). Make others with of(String, Function). Vars compare by identity: routes share a trie branch only when they use the same Var instance, so declare custom ones as constants.
